source.author: Sedani Sejal Rasiklal
source.title: Intermittent and stepwise decremental microwave power drying of green leafy vegetables
source.publisher: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola

sample_scope: Fresh market mint, washed; leaves separated from root and stem, damaged leaves removed, before drying. Cultivar, batch variability and supermarket cut-pack yield are not reported.
model: Bridge the reported leaf fraction per purchased gram to the existing reviewed generic mint usable-gram basis. Required generic edible input = leaf grams * 0.85 / 0.5464. These are independent reference estimates, not a jointly observed conditional yield or a product declaration.
applicability: Only the already reviewed exact cut-fresh-mint contexts with the 0.85 generic edible projection. Explicit estimated-purchase consent and an issued leaf-trimming operand are mandatory. Weigh actual usable input and picked leaves; short output blocks consumption and requires reconciliation.
